title: Industrial Edge Computing: Powering Secure and Reliable IIoT Networks
description: Introducing the INV CI X7425E, the latest 6 port Networking Device, featuring 2 COM ports, 4 USB 2.0 ports, 2 SIM slots, all ready to deliver on Edge AI networking capabilities.

content.text: As industrial operations grow more distributed and data-intensive, edge computing has emerged as a foundational layer in modern IIoT deployments. Rather than routing all sensor data back to a central cloud, edge devices process, filter, and act on data at the source — reducing latency, bandwidth costs, and dependency on continuous connectivity.

Invendis is pleased to introduce the INV CI X7425E — a compact, ruggedised 6-port edge compute device designed for demanding industrial environments. Built around the Intel Alder Lake platform, the X7425E combines compute performance with the I/O flexibility required for real-world field deployments.

items: 6 × Gigabit Ethernet ports for high-throughput local networking
2 × COM (RS-232/RS-485) ports for legacy serial device integration
4 × USB 2.0 ports for peripheral and storage connectivity
2 × SIM card slots supporting dual-SIM LTE/5G failover
Intel Alder Lake-N processor with integrated AI inference acceleration

content.text: Edge AI at the Network Boundary

The X7425E's Intel SoC includes a built-in NPU (Neural Processing Unit), enabling on-device inference for applications such as anomaly detection, predictive maintenance triggers, and real-time quality inspection — without sending raw data off-site.

content.title: Deployment Note
content.text: The X7425E ships with Invendis's PizGloria management software pre-configured, enabling zero-touch provisioning and remote fleet management from day one.

For sectors such as telecom infrastructure monitoring, solar site supervision, and industrial automation, the X7425E delivers the processing headroom and connectivity resilience needed to run reliable IIoT applications at scale.
